author: reek
body: It surfaced as `interval-exhaustive` reporting 119123 unsound answers from a subtraction transfer function that was correct, because the concrete operator it was checked against had collapsed to the last arm of its own if-chain.

author: reek
body: The join is owed whatever the then-branch computes, so a few more encodings ride along: a subtraction, a product, and a nested if.

author: reek
body: The chain that started it: every arm must be reachable, not just the last one.
